# Butler v0.0.17

## Change Log

- Recovered durable turn outcomes from safe command and file-tool evidence so
  Butler can finish with the work already completed instead of falling back to a
  generic evidence-failure response. (#45)
- Made limited-delivery recovery use concrete progress and durable-output
  signals, reducing dead-end answers when the model cannot produce the ideal
  final response shape. (#45)
- Hardened evidence receipts for command-created files, verified output paths,
  tables, and charts while keeping private paths and raw tool output out of
  user-facing recovery text. (#45)
